1.0.0.en: First release! Turn a Reachy Mini robot into Eyes, Ears, and a Voice for Homey: speak text, announce the time and weather, choose a TTS voice (Google, OpenAI, or ElevenLabs), face-detected and heard-speech triggers, two-way conversation mode, expressive gestures and emotions, and voice control of your home (lights, TVs, speakers, and more).

1.1.0.en: Voice upgrade: OpenAI text-to-speech now defaults to the HD model with voice and model pickers, and automatically falls back to the free Google voice if no API key is set. Settings with fixed choices are now dropdowns. In conversation mode, Reachy can now tell you the real current time and weather.

1.2.0.en: Easier for everyone to install: you now enter your own Reachy Mini's address when pairing, a new in-app Voice Control setup page generates the exact robot configuration for you, and Reachy automatically recovers if it ever slumps into standby after a reboot.

1.2.1.en: Fixes the pairing screen so you can enter your Reachy Mini's address and connect to it when adding the device.

1.2.2.en: Fixed images and icons. Shorter Readme.txt and Description. Updated app.json.

1.3.0.en: Adds automatic discovery: your Reachy Mini is now found on the network while pairing, so you can add it with a single tap instead of typing an IP address. A paired robot also keeps working if its IP address changes.

1.3.1.en: New app image showing the Reachy Mini in a real workspace.

1.4.0.en: Voice control is now SSH-free: install the new Homey Companion app on your Reachy Mini from the robot's app store, then just paste your Homey app URL and API key on its settings page — no more SSH. The Start conversation action launches the companion automatically (and falls back to the standard conversation app if it isn't installed). The in-app setup page has been updated to match.

1.4.1.en: Fixes Reachy's head drooping into standby while in conversation mode: the app now keeps the conversation app's head held up during idle silence, without interrupting the conversation.

1.5.0.en: Reachy now remembers. In conversation mode it can recall what you told it earlier — your name, preferences, or plans — even after a reboot or app update, so you can pick up where you left off and ask "do you remember…?". The memory is kept small and lives on your Homey, and you can tell Reachy to forget it any time.
